contradicting_evidence: A bearish interpretation remains plausible: current proxy breadth has only 25 advancers against 73 decliners, while BTC hourly taker-buy quote share is approximately 46% and the earlier BTC taker imbalance is negative.
A bullish interpretation also remains plausible: BTC and ETH completed the hour higher, ETH/BTC strengthened, and ETH spot taker-buy participation exceeded half.
Settled ETF outflows and contracting stablecoin supply weigh against recovery, but their observation cadence does not reliably determine the next 12 hours.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Short rebound attempts and renewed selling tests are both credible. The latest hour shows stabilization, particularly in ETH, but provides insufficient evidence to distinguish a developing recovery from a temporary pause after the broader decline.
falsification_conditions: A sustained sequence of higher BTC and ETH closes accompanied by stronger spot buying, persistent ETH/BTC improvement and broader participation would replace NO_EDGE with an upside case.
Renewed synchronized BTC and ETH declines, persistent aggressive spot selling and deteriorating fresh breadth would replace NO_EDGE with a downside case.
missing_evidence: Follow-through after the single supplied completed hourly candle.
Repeated order-book and trade-flow observations showing whether displayed liquidity persists and executed demand strengthens.
Fresh comparable breadth observations demonstrating whether participation is expanding or merely fluctuating.
supporting_evidence: BTC rose approximately 0.06%, ETH 0.28% and ETH/BTC 0.25% over the completed hour: positive but insufficient to establish continuation.
Both BTC and ETH show PRICE_UP_OI_DOWN. This is compatible with position reduction and does not establish fresh directional commitment.
Positive displayed-depth imbalance coexists with negative BTC taker imbalance and positive ETH taker imbalance, leaving immediate demand signals divided.
The freshest breadth reading remains weak at 25%. The older 13% reading is from the same upstream family with different membership and is neither an independent vote nor proof of durable improvement.
